title: My Family
text:
My name is Ana. I live with my family in a small house. My mother is a teacher. My father works in a shop. We have a dog named Bob.

I have one brother. His name is Pedro. He is seven years old. On Sundays, we eat lunch together. We like to play games after lunch.

questions.text: What is the name of the family's dog?
What can we infer about Ana's family?
options: They are a happy family who spend time together
They do not like to eat together
They live in a big apartment in the city
They do not have any pets

questions.text: Why do Ana and Pedro probably enjoy Sundays?
options: They eat lunch together and play games
They go to school on Sundays
They work in a shop together
They have a teacher at home

vocabulary.definition: with another person or other people
a boy or man who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Ana. Eu moro com a minha família em uma casa pequena. Minha mãe é professora. Meu pai trabalha em uma loja. Nós temos um cachorro chamado Bob.
Eu tenho um irmão. O nome dele é Pedro. Ele tem sete anos. Aos domingos, nós almoçamos juntos. Gostamos de jogar jogos depois do almoço.
